en.title: GTA 6: 10 Essential First Steps for Your Leonida Adventure
en.summary: Don't get lost in Vice City's chaos. This list guides you through the crucial first hours of GTA 6, ensuring you make the most of Rockstar's massive new world.
en.body:
## 1. Don't Rush the Story
The main narrative of GTA 6 is a sprawling 50-hour epic with over 100 missions, so resist the urge to speedrun. Take your time to truly absorb the atmosphere of Leonida and its vibrant characters, as the game is designed for exploration and emergent moments between major plot points.

## 2. Explore Key Lento Thoroughly
This initial hub is your sandbox for learning the ropes. Spend time here absorbing the environment, discovering hidden details, and engaging with the world before venturing further, as it offers a concentrated dose of what the full map provides.

## 3. Master the New Driving Mechanics
Vice City's streets are more intricate than ever. Practicing the updated driving physics, especially with the new car scanner feature, will be vital for navigating chases and escaping the law effectively from the get-go.

## 4. Engage with Random NPC Interactions
Rockstar's worlds are renowned for their life-like inhabitants. Don't just pass them by; engage with NPCs, as these spontaneous encounters can lead to unexpected side quests, humorous dialogue, or even crucial information that enriches your playthrough.

## 5. Prioritize Crime Practice
Becoming a proficient criminal is essential for survival and success. Start practicing robbery techniques and hone your skills in evading law enforcement early on, as this will prepare you for the higher stakes later in the game.

## 6. Invest in a Suppressor
Stealth is often the best approach, especially in the early game. Acquiring a suppressor for your weapons early on will significantly help in executing cleaner heists and avoiding unwanted attention from the police.

## 7. Embrace the New Wanted System
Understanding how the updated wanted level system works is crucial. Learn its nuances, from how heat accumulates to how different escape tactics affect it, to ensure you can disappear more effectively when the heat is on.

## 8. Explore the 70% of Enterable Buildings
GTA 6 boasts a massive number of interior locations. Make it a mission to enter as many buildings as possible, as these spaces often contain valuable loot, hidden secrets, or unique environmental storytelling elements.

## 9. Customize Your Character
Personalization is a core part of the GTA experience. Spend some time in the early hours customizing your character's appearance, from clothing to accessories, to truly make your protagonist your own.

## 10. Don't Skip Side Activities
Beyond the main missions, Leonida is packed with optional content. Whether it's engaging in street races, visiting the gym, or even going on dates, these side activities offer valuable rewards and add depth to your overall experience.
Bottom Line: Prioritize exploration, skill-building, and embracing the chaos to make your first hours in GTA 6 unforgettable.

content_raw: GTA 6 is out and Rockstar’s huge open world can be mighty intimidating for players just jumping in. So, we’ve put together a bunch of tips to guide new players to the missions, objectives and items they should prioritise across those first few hours!
